source: Autoregressive decode is different. For a single new token,ZXMATH0000XZ may be one whileZXMATH0001XZ is the accumulated context length. The operation reads a large KV cache but produces only one new query row per sequence. In that regime, KV-cache bandwidth and serving/batching behavior can dominate, and specialized decode kernels matter. The official repository exposes flash_attn_with_kvcache, which can update and attend to the cache in one kernel and supports features such as ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ and optional RoPE handling.[8]
zh: 自回归解码则不同。对于单个新令牌，ZXMATH0000XZ 可能是 1，而 ZXMATH0001XZ 是累积的上下文长度。该操作读取大量 KV 缓存，但每个序列仅生成一个新查询行。在这种情况下，KV 缓存带宽和服务/批处理行为可能占主导地位，并且专门的解码内核很重要。官方存储库公开了 flash_attn_with_kvcache，它可以更新和处理一个内核中的缓存，并支持 ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ 和可选 RoPE 处理等功能。 [8]
